episodes.title: The Recruit
episodes.summary: X-wing pilot Kazuda Xiono is recruited for the Resistance, but finds himself in over his head when Poe Dameron assigns him to a remote fueling station to spy on the First Order. Then, after Kaz boasts about being the best pilot around, he is forced to compete in a dangerous sky race.

episodes.title: The Triple Dark
episodes.summary: Kaz and BB-8 uncover information on an imminent pirate attack and must find a way to stop it.

episodes.title: Fuel for the Fire
episodes.summary: Kaz befriends a sky racer named Rucklin who pressures him to take some rare and dangerous hyperfuel hidden in Yeager's office.

episodes.title: The High Tower
episodes.summary: The First Order arrives at the platform for mysterious reasons and Kaz and BB-8 are determined to sneak into the tower to find out what they want.

episodes.title: The Children from Tehar
episodes.summary: Kaz searches for two missing children for a sizeable reward only to discover the First Order is also hunting for them.

episodes.title: Signal from Sector Six
episodes.summary: When out on a routine training exercise, a distress signal sends Kaz and Poe to a damaged ship with strange lifeforms onboard.

episodes.title: Synara's Score
episodes.summary: On a mission to repair a vital platform defense, Kaz befriends the mysterious Synara and comes under attack by pirates.

episodes.title: The Platform Classic
episodes.summary: An upcoming race reunites Yeager with his estranged brother, Marcus, who needs to win to pay off his debt to a criminal organization.

episodes.title: Secrets and Holograms
episodes.summary: When a determined Kaz tries to discover the truth about Captain Doza, he and Torra embark on an adventure where they uncover more about the tower than either bargained for.

episodes.title: Station Theta Black
episodes.summary: When Poe and Kaz find an old First Order mining facility, BB-8 discovers the facility isn't so abandoned.

episodes.title: Bibo
episodes.summary: Neeku adopts a strange sea creature and gets way more than he bargained for when it brings chaos to the platform.

episodes.title: Dangerous Business
episodes.summary: In exchange for parts, Kaz minds acquisitions for Flix and Orka and comes into conflict with a shady alien customer in league with the First Order.

episodes.title: The Doza Dilemma
episodes.summary: Synara settles into life on the platform, but her pirate compatriots have other plans for her.

episodes.title: The First Order Occupation
episodes.summary: Kaz scrambles to help Synara escape the platform as the First Order sends a contingent of stormtroopers to hunt a spy.

episodes.title: The New Trooper
episodes.summary: When Kel and Eila seek out Kaz's help after knocking out a stormtrooper, Kaz dons the trooper's armor to protect the kids and spy on the First Order.

episodes.title: The Core Problem
episodes.summary: Poe and Kaz make an unsettling discovery and must evade the First Order when they are spotted by an enemy probe droid.

episodes.title: The Disappeared
episodes.summary: Kaz and Torra investigate the disappearance of a friend and plan to free them from the First Order.

episodes.title: Descent
episodes.summary: With secrets exposed, Yeager's crew must evade relentless troopers hunting them down and find a way to reach the Resistance.

episodes.title: No Escape: Part 1
episodes.summary: Kaz, Neeku, Torra devise a plan to free their friends, but it's upended when Kaz bears witness to the full might of the First Order.

episodes.title: No Escape: Part 2
episodes.summary: With Neeku's help, Kaz comes up with a risky plan to rid the Colossus of the First Order once and for all.

episodes.title: Into the Unknown
episodes.summary: After being launched into space by Kaz and crew, the Colossus encounters engineering problems, which are made worse by a mysterious stowaway.

episodes.title: A Quick Salvage Run
episodes.summary: With the Colossus in need of hyperfuel, Kaz suggests they take it from a downed First Order ship; the salvage mission is quickly compromised when the First Order shows up.

episodes.title: Live Fire
episodes.summary: Kaz officially joins the Aces, as does Yeager — who trains them to become better combat pilots; Tam learns what it's like to be a First Order pilot.

episodes.title: Hunt on Celsor 3
episodes.summary: The pirates volunteer to find food for the Colossus, but Kaz doesn't trust them; Kaz and Torra go on the hunt, but run into big problems.

episodes.title: The Engineer
episodes.summary: Kaz and Neeku discover Nena, a Nikto engineer in need of assistance, who barely escaped a First Order attack.

episodes.title: From Beneath
episodes.summary: Flix takes Kaz and crew to his homeworld to acquire fuel from his family's refinery, only to discover the family's drilling has awoken something monstrous.

episodes.title: The Relic Raiders
episodes.summary: When Kaz and the team arrive on a mysterious planet to buy supplies, they find the outpost has been abandoned and a secret Sith Temple has been raised.

episodes.title: Rendezvous Point
episodes.summary: Doza attempts to meet a Resistance pilot from his past. Meanwhile, the pilot has been captured by the First Order.

episodes.title: The Voxx Vortex 5000
episodes.summary: With the Colossus running out of money, Hype risks everything by taking the Aces to race at Vranki's Casino, run by Vranki the Hutt.

episodes.title: Kaz's Curse
episodes.summary: A pirate curses Kaz, causing him danger at every turn; Kaz is soon forced to seek Mika Grey for help, but Kaz's curse gets worse when the Guavian Death Gang appears.

episodes.title: Station to Station
episodes.summary: Kaz and Neeku sneak onto a First Order refueling station in order to take an important piece of tech, but their plans go awry when they run into Tam and Gen. Hux.

episodes.title: The Missing Agent
episodes.summary: Kaz, Yeager and Synara trace a distress call to a planet where a Resistance agent has gone missing; things only get worse as a mysterious bounty hunter starts hunting them.

episodes.title: Breakout
episodes.summary: Kaz and Norath try to help their friends while being pursued by a deadly bounty hunter.

episodes.title: The Mutiny
episodes.summary: Kragan buys a secret weapon (battle droids) to capture the Colossus and take over; when Synara discovers the plan, she tries to warn Kaz and crew, but it may be too late.

episodes.title: The New World
episodes.summary: Doza takes the Colossus to a hidden world on the outer rim, only to find it's inhabited by beings who don't like them.

episodes.title: No Place Safe
episodes.summary: Kaz decides to join with Poe and the Resistance, but things go awry when he discovers the First Order has located the Colossus.

episodes.title: Rebuilding the Resistance
episodes.summary: Resistance recruits need an escort getting off of Dantooine; unfortunately, Tam is assigned to destroy the recruits.

episodes.title: The Escape
episodes.summary: Kaz and Yeager attempt to rescue Tam from the First Order while trying to evade capture on a Star Destroyer; the Colossus is in trouble and faces an impossible choice.
